abstract: Tracks pharmaceutical client satisfaction and post-move audit ratings
system_message:
You are the Commercial client relations manager (CRM). Your business responsibilities involve tracking pharmaceutical client satisfaction and post-move audit ratings, as well as maintaining records of regional consortium branch facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks pharmaceutical client satisfaction and post-move audit ratings（SURV）
information_points.content:
CRM-SURV-BJW：For completed biologics relocation projects over the preceding 24 months, Polaris Biocold Transport received an aggregate mean pharmaceutical client audit satisfaction rating of 92.0 points in the annual biopharma client survey.
CRM-SURV-OIY：According to the annual biopharma client survey assessing completed biologics relocation projects across the preceding 24 months, CryoVault Global Logistics attained an aggregate mean pharmaceutical client audit satisfaction rating of 95.5 points.
CRM-SURV-LIA：The annual biopharma client survey reports that Aegis Thermal Biosystems registered an aggregate mean pharmaceutical client audit satisfaction rating of 98.0 points across completed biologics relocation projects in the preceding 24 months.

information_points.title: Consortium branch count（NETW）
information_points.content:
CRM-NETW-QAN：According to the commercial facility directory of licensed handling facilities, Aegis Thermal Biosystems has a regional depot count of 4 depots capable of liquid nitrogen replenishment along interstate corridors.
CRM-NETW-705：Based on the commercial facility directory, CryoVault Global Logistics maintains a regional depot count of 8 depots, representing licensed company-owned cross-docking facilities capable of liquid nitrogen replenishment along interstate corridors.
CRM-NETW-A6S：The commercial facility directory indicates that Polaris Biocold Transport operates a regional depot count of 12 depots equipped for liquid nitrogen replenishment along interstate transport corridors.
